COMPONENT PATTERN Z-2 — CONTEXTUAL CLOSET GROWTH PROMPT PATTERN

9:41

Gentle ways to grow.

Reusable prompts appear after the user completes the main task.

Created outfit

Own the shoes in this look?

Trip planned

Marked worn

Behavior specification

Frequency-limit prompts, persist dismissals, deduplicate by item and trigger, record last-shown time, and never block the main flow.
